messages:
sana: Quick flag 1: our per-model unit-cost card is showing wildly different cache savings when the new sticky-routing policy is enabled for routes that do canary fallbacks. example tenant 'gamma-labs' went from $0.003/token saved to $-0.001/token. pasted trace and sample rows.
dmitri: yikes. that suggests either (a) credits are being attached to the wrong invocation path, or (b) we're attributing prefetch credits to the hotpath after sticky routing switches model instances.
lena: can you dump the raw events? I want to see the sequence of routing events and whether credit_source is set on each record.
sana: pasted small CSV excerpt:
```
invocation_id,tenant,route,model,route_phase,credit,token_cost,timestamp
inv-1001,gamma-labs,/search,v1,hotpath,0.0,0.006,2026-03-19T10:01:12Z
inv-1002,gamma-labs,/search,v1,prefetch,0.004,0.001,2026-03-19T10:01:13Z
inv-1003,gamma-labs,/search,v1,fallback,0.0,0.005,2026-03-19T10:01:14Z
```
rachel: notice inv-1002 credit looks right, but our aggregator groups by (tenant, model) and loses route_phase. aggregator SQL: 
```
SELECT tenant, model, SUM(token_cost) as cost, SUM(prefetch_credit) as credits
FROM econ_invocations
WHERE day = '2026-03-19'
GROUP BY tenant, model
```
mikel: grouping only by tenant+model will mix together prefetch credits applied on one route with hotpath cost on another. we need to preserve route_phase or at least have credit provenance in the rollup.
dmitri: also the sticky-routing changes introduced a join to routing_metadata that duplicates rows for routed copies, which could double-count cost in some windows. I saw a LEFT JOIN -> UNNEST pattern.
lena: reproduction: enable sticky-route on a small route, do 200 invocations with intermittent fallback to cold-model, then run aggregations with and without route_phase. numbers diverge by ~30%.
sana: immediate mitigation: show a warning on the card when route_phase cardinality > 1 for the (tenant,model) pair: "Multiple request phases detected 1. Data may be aggregated across prefetch/fallback."
mikel: longer fix: change nightly ETL to emit nested dimensions: tenant, model, route_phase (hotpath/prefetch/fallback) and a normalized_cost field that accounts for sampling and routing-duplication flags. create a mapping to reduce dim cardinality for customers who want simpler rollups.
devops-bot: created ticket ECO-827: Preserve route_phase in econ rollups and dedupe duplicate route joins. Related CI check at https://ci.internal/pipelines/827.
rachel: UX follow-up: if we add route_phase to the rollup, the card will become wider. Suggest we keep default view aggregated but expose a small expansion panel "breakdown by phase" that flips the rollup into a 3-row mini-table.
dmitri: agree. also add a debug-only toggle in the console to show raw attribution events (for support).
lena: I'll draft the ETL change: add columns (route_phase, normalized_cost, sample_rate, event_hash) and change the join to routing_metadata to use a dedupe subquery by event_hash. I'll add unit tests for the UNNEST case.
sana: assignment thoughts:
- lena: ETL PR (ECO-827) - alter schema + dedupe logic
- dmitri: audit joins + add CI test for duplicate routing rows
- rachel: UI expand/collapse + warning pill + debug toggle copy
- mikel: synthetic sim harness for sticky-routing flows and an integration smoke test

rachel: UI note 1: warning pill copy: "Phase-mixed data (prefetch + hotpath). Toggle breakdown to inspect." and tooltip: "Routing policies (sticky/canary) can cause credits and costs to land on different phases; use breakdown to verify per-phase economics."
devops-bot: ECO-827 created and linked PRs: ETL-1091, UI-1092, SIM-1093. Rollout checklist includes 48h sentinel watch and runbook snippet.
mikel: timeline: ETL change + sim + UI tweak in 3 workdays? ETL needs schema migration window. we should flag the night with low traffic to run migration.
dmitri: one more gotcha: existing chargeback exports rely on tenant+model keys. we'll need a compatibility export that collapses route_phase for downstream billing consumers. add an exporter shim.
lena: noted, adding shard-compatible export flag.
sana: thanks team. can someone post a short note in #incidents if the sentinel fires after deploy? I'd rather catch noisy support tickets early.
devops-bot: alert rule econ-phase-mismatch created (threshold 5% of tenants with negative per-token savings) 1 quiet window 2h.
rachel: ack. I'll sketch the expand UI tonight and drop a screenshot in the thread tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
